import numpy as np

m = Unit('m')
cm = Unit('cm')
q = np.array([0.0]).view(Quantity)
q._set_unit(m)

result = q._result_as_quantity(
    (
        np.array([[1.5, 2.5], [3.5, 4.5]]),
        np.array([10.0, 20.0, 30.0]),
    ),
    (m, cm),
    None,
)

for item in result:
    print(type(item).__name__)
    print(item)
    print(item.unit)
    print(item.shape)
